description_en: Configures a trust relationship for an AD office network. For office networks (formerly workspaces) that use the HDX protocol, you must configure conditional forwarders and trust relationships before the networks can function properly
description_zh: 对于采用HDX协议的办公网络（原工作区），需要配置条件转发器和信任关系后方可正常使用。可调用本接口为AD办公网络配置信任关系
kebab_example: aliyun ecd config-ad-connector-trust --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-7784180000 --trust-key password123000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigADConnectorTrust

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AD office network
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The trust password. This password is the one that you specified when you configured the trust relationship (that is, established a trust relationship with Elastic Desktop Service ecd.acs) in the AD domain
parameters.help_zh: 信任密码。该密码为AD域中配置信任关系（即与无影ecd.acs建立信任关系）时设置的密码
parameters.name: trust_key

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to configure the trust password for the RDS License Domain of the AD office network
parameters.help_zh: 判断是否是为AD办公网络的RDS License Domain配置信任密码
parameters.name: rds_license_domain
